description.value: Persia Foods is a family-owned, Lower Mainland grocery chain operating since 1996, known for affordable fresh produce and a wide range of ethnically diverse foods. The West Vancouver Marine Drive location is one of nine stores across the region. It markets itself as offering Vancouver's most affordable groceries, making it a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the North Shore corridor.

No mention of bike parking, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears in the website text or OSM tags; basic groceries are confirmed by the greengrocer tag and the website's emphasis on fresh, affordable produce and ethnically diverse foods.
